<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Pure immutable metadata in core; CLI parses and renders injected descriptor references; the existing app registry owns each descriptor and its executable runner. No new dependency, discovery service, plugin loader or environment expansion. |
| composition_root | crates/app/src/adapters.rs |
| contracts | core exports serializable AdapterDescriptor {id, application, description, locations, capabilities}; all string/slice data is static and I/O-free. No duplicate generic limitations field; explicit capability values carry unsupported behaviors., LocationHint {platforms, base, path, session_glob, storage_format}; base=home is symbolic and never expanded. Claude usual hint is .claude/projects with */*.jsonl; paths remain caller-overridable., AdapterCapabilities {export_platforms, output_formats, sdk_caller_owned_cursor, cursor_source_assumption, cli_persisted_resume, delayed_revision_reconciliation, lossless_archive}; current platforms=[unix], format=[otlp-jsonl], caller-owned cursor=true, source assumption=append_only, and remaining three booleans=false. A cursor is a mechanism, not safety under rewrite/regrowth/truncation-above-checkpoint., CLI run_adapters(Vec&lt;OsString&gt;, &CliContext, &[&AdapterDescriptor], &mut dyn Write, &mut dyn Write) -&gt; u8; reuse JSON/human/help/failure output conventions. Successful JSON is {ok:true,command:adapters.list,v:1,data:{adapters:[...]}}., Existing AdapterRegistration stores descriptor+run; const array and stack descriptor-reference projection serve catalog and session selection from descriptor.id. No duplicate ID/name registry., Production descriptor.id must equal emitted unisphere.source.adapter. production_catalog_ids_match_exported_provenance iterates the actual production registry and exports its fixture through each runner, not a parallel catalog or handwritten identity-pair assertion., CLI JSON failures use {ok:false,command:adapters.list,v:1,error:...} with existing safe core failure fields; JSON goes to stdout, human failures to stderr, output-write failures exit1 without appending a second envelope. Human success lists id/application/description, symbolic location hints and capability values, explicitly stating hints are not detected installations. Piped output defaults JSON; terminal output defaults human; --json/--human override after adapters. |
